fusions.name: Strip the Canvas
fusions.desc: Sends a cloud into the first enemy it meets that deals 11 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Swarm Over the Rail
fusions.desc: Looses 4 small biting shapes in a spread, each one deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Cloud Off the Bow
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm within 5 tiles for 10 seconds that strikes nearby enemies for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Stores Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
